title: fix(pm): let check-widening-tells' T1 express that the REMOVED value accepted everything
body:
Fixes #18234

Clause-②: no

`scripts/pm/**` is shipped by no package (measured below), and a precision fix to a gate
moves no published contract face. Re-judged from the actual diff: one file,
`scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`.

## What moved

T1 says of itself "the accept set gains a spelling an author may now write", and it fired on
a diff that takes a spelling away: a key narrowed OUT of `z.unknown()` — zod's universal
acceptor — into `z.union([...])`. `'stage=won'` and `42` were admitted before and are refused
now, so the accept set SHRANK.

The finding is the control set, not that reasoning: the SAME removal DECLINED when the
replacement was spelled `z.array(z.any())` and FIRED when the identical narrowing was spelled
`z.union([`. One semantic change, two opposite verdicts, decided by nothing but whether the
added value's first line opens a closed-set constructor.

#16943's replacement budget was EARNED (the removed `filter:` line is T1-shaped and buys one
T1 unit) and then refused at the SPEND, because #17618 lets a closed-set-valued key spend only
on three facts, the second of which — both member lists readable on their own line — a
universal acceptor can never carry. It has no member list, and that is precisely the case
where no comparison is needed: the removed set is the UNIVERSE, so every replacement is a
subset of it by construction.

So this adds a SECOND way to supply #17618's own requirement — positive, block-local evidence
that the set gained nothing, carried by the REMOVED value's semantics instead of by a list
comparison. Nothing about the added value's spelling is read; that variable is the defect.

## This is the "no longer false-positives" side, proven, not the "reports less" side

The triage ruling draws the line: "stop it false-positiving" and "make it report less" may
differ by one condition in code and sit on opposite sides of the charter. Everything that
should still fire, still fires:

| case | patch | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| live (objectui#9540) | `- filter: z.unknown()...` then `+ filter: z.union([` (members on later lines) | FIRES T1 | **declines** |
| control A | the SAME removal then `+ filter: z.array(z.any()).optional()...` | declines | declines |
| control B | a genuinely new key, nothing removed | FIRES | **FIRES** |
| control C | `z.enum(['a','b'])` then `z.enum(['a','b','c'])` | FIRES | **FIRES** |
| control D | `z.enum(['a','b','c'])` then `z.enum(['a','b'])` | declines | declines |
| dark control (new) | the live pair's ADDED lines with NOTHING removed | FIRES | **FIRES** |
| different key (new) | `- legacyFilter: z.unknown()` then `+ filter: z.union([` | FIRES | **FIRES** |
| never universal (new) | `- filter: z.string()` then `+ filter: z.union([` | FIRES | **FIRES** |
| narrowing step (new) | `- filter: z.unknown().refine(...)` then `+ filter: z.union([` | FIRES | **FIRES** |
| surplus (new) | the live pair PLUS one genuinely new key in the same block | FIRES | **FIRES** (the new key) |
| `z.any()` (new) | `- filter: z.any()` then `+ filter: z.union([` | FIRES | **declines** |

The recognition keys on the REMOVED value being a universal acceptor, never on the spelling of
the added one: a `z.discriminatedUnion` and a `z.literal` replacement read the same as the
`z.union` one, and the `z.array(z.any())` spelling is unchanged.

## Evidence

### 1. The live pair, on the bytes objectui#9540 actually pushed

Fetched by ref, never `FETCH_HEAD`: `git fetch --depth 3 origin refs/pull/9540/head:pr9540`,
head `3e60765fb4a80c3ee5c098b8133a26533de39842`, diff `3e60765^..3e60765` (4 files).

- gate at `21b7c12b4` (this branch's base): `exit 4`, `T1 packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:1811 — + filter: z.union([` — byte-identical to the C5 row on the card.
- gate at this branch: `exit 0`, "4 changed file(s) — 1 judged against a declared surface (no widening tell), 3 NOT MEASURED".

`PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 9540`
from THIS seat exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET — `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/pulls` is
HTTP 403 for this credential, with and without the token). That is a transport refusal, not a
reading, so the line above is measured on the tell half — the half this PR moves — against the
PR's real bytes.

### 2. The self-test battery: 309 cases before, 342 after

`pnpm check:pm-widening-tells` — exit 0. Every pre-existing case is unchanged (309 passed on
the matcher change alone, before any case was added). The new battery is 33 cases, pinned at 33
in `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`, and the firing half is written first: the dark control, a different
key, a value that was never universal, a `.refine()`d one, an inline enum widened in place, a
genuine new key on an exhausted budget, and a set whose list opens on a later line.

### 3. Ablations, with on-disk evidence

All three through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, before/after counts,
`git hash-object` change, proven restore, EXIT/INT/TERM trap). Blob `092294bc786b` at HEAD for
every leg, and every leg restored to it with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| leg | mutation | blob after | self-test |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | delete the new spend disjunct | `e344d529aa73` | 9 of 342 FAIL |
| B | add `refine|pipe` to the inert chain vocabulary | `7dbb79274529` | 3 of 342 FAIL |
| C | drop the key-identity requirement | mutated, restore proven | 2 of 342 FAIL |

### 4. History simulation — 1,048 commits, zero rows move

Every commit in this checkout touching `packages/spec` (1,048), diffed at `--unified=3` and
judged by BOTH module versions in one process:

- rows raised by the base gate: **20,360**; by this branch: **20,360**
- rows that now decline: **0**. Rows that BEGIN firing: **0**. Commits whose verdict moved: **0**.

Harness control (the reading is not "the two modules are one module"): the same harness reports
the live pair as `T1@1811` under the base gate and `[]` under this branch, and reports control B
firing under both. The landed population of the repaired class in this repo is therefore ZERO —
the live carrier is in the sibling repo — which is why the decline is proven by the live pair,
the battery and the ablations rather than by this simulation.

### 5. Counts, each with a firing control

- **the universal-acceptor class, measured not assumed** — zod 4.4.3, `safeParse` over `42`,
  `'stage=won'`, `null`, `undefined`, `{}`, `[]`, `true` and a function: `z.unknown()`,
  `z.any()` and both with `.optional()` accept all eight. Firing control on the same probe:
  `z.unknown().refine(v => typeof v === 'string')` accepts ONE of the eight, and
  `z.union([z.array(z.any()), z.record(z.string(), z.any())])` accepts two — the narrowing this
  card is about.
- **the chain vocabulary** — 132 key lines on `packages/spec/src` + `packages/runtime/src`
  open `z.unknown()` (127) or `z.any()` (5); the whole tail vocabulary is `.optional()` (89),
  `.describe()` (84), `.meta()` (1). Nothing else appears, so the allowlist is those three and
  every other step leaves the tell firing.
- **line termination** — 99 of those 132 terminate the value on their own line, 29 end with a
  balanced `)` that continues on the next line, 4 end inside an open `(`. The reading is
  line-local, so the 33 keep telling (the loud direction).
- **`z.custom()` is deliberately NOT declared** — 0 code occurrences in those two trees (3 text
  hits, all prose in a docblock or test comment). Firing control: the same scan finds all 132
  acceptor lines. A row for a shape no tree carries is dead data, and `z.custom(fn)` narrows.

## skip-changeset, measured

70 manifests in this repo declare a `files[]`; none of them names `scripts/pm`, and the changed
file lives outside every package directory. Firing control on the same reader:
`packages/lint` reads back `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`. Nothing published moves.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 29
commands for this diff (identical before and after merging `origin/main`). All 29 were run with
the exit code captured before any pipe, and reconciled with `--ran`; results are in the report
comment on #18234.

## Acceptance notes

⚠️ **Noted, not filed here — the INVERSE direction is unreported.** A key re-typed INTO a
universal acceptor (`z.union([...])` then `z.unknown()`) is a real widening and raises no tell.
That silence is #16943's replacement budget and it PREDATES this PR: measured identical at
`21b7c12b4`, with the new-key and widened-enum controls firing on the same harness. It is not
repaired here because reporting it changes the budget for EVERY key rather than for this class,
which is a different card's scope. The battery asserts it as a quiet direction, so the case
reds the day it is repaired.

⚠️ **Residual, in the loud direction.** A removed acceptor whose chain WRAPS onto a second line
is not certified and its replacement still fires (33 of 132 lines on this tree take that
spelling). The overturn condition is written into the header: the first landed pair whose
removed acceptor wraps closes it by reading the block's removed run forward instead of one line.
